MODIMOLLE-MOOKGOPHONG (LIM 368, Limpopo) - TAX INVOICE/STATEMENT OF ACCOUNT, same billing vendor (eMunsoft) as KwaDukuza / Abaqulusi / Alfred Duma / Bela-Bela / Emalahleni. Masthead 'Modimolle Mookgophong Local Municipality / PRIVATE BAG X1008 MODIMOLLE 0510'. Fingerprint pinned on that masthead AND VAT number 4140278328; both verified present in exactly the 10 bills of this account and nowhere else in the 219-PDF Telkom tree. Account [number removed], one site (LANDDROSSTRAAT 50, TOWN NYLSTROOM / MODIMOLLE), statements 31 JAN 2025 -> 31 JUL 2026.

THIS IS THE RICHEST BILL IN THE FAMILY - A REAL TOU / LARGE POWER USER STATEMENT.
Only ONE meter-table variant occurs here: METER NO. / METER TYPE / OLD READING / NEW READING / READING DATE / READING TYPE / CONSUMPTION (single reading date, no date range) - the Bela-Bela / Emalahleni-variant-A shape. All 65 meter rows on all 10 bills have exactly these 7 columns. There is NO period start anywhere -> Start Date is '_none'.

METER TABLE
- METER TYPE values: 'TIME OF USE' (the three kWh registers), 'KVA' (two demand registers), 'WATER'.
- The three TIME OF USE registers are the Peak / Standard / Off-peak kWh registers, but on the OLD meter ([number removed]) they are printed WITHOUT any register suffix, so the meter table alone cannot tell you which register is which band. On the NEW meter the suffix letters are explicit: [number removed]P / ...S / ...O are TIME OF USE and ...A / ...K are KVA (the Mbombela suffix convention). CONSEQUENCE: the per-band kWh and Rands are taken from the LEDGER codes (TOU01P/S/O), never from the meter table - the meter table only supplies Start/End Reading and Total kWh (summed over the TIME OF USE rows). Verified on all 10 bills: sum(TIME OF USE CONSUMPTION) == TOU01P + TOU01S + TOU01O units, and END-START == that same figure.
- KVA rows print OLD .000 -> NEW = the month's demand level and CONSUMPTION = NEW READING (a level, not a difference). Both KVA registers are billed, one as TOU03K 'DEMAND CHARGE' and one as TOU03A 'ACCESS CHARGE', and on the old meter they are indistinguishable in the table (bill 1 has FOUR KVA rows), so Demand kVA / NMD kVA are taken from the LEDGER units, not the meter table.
- MULTI-METER: bill 'LIM_...[number removed].pdf' (31 MAR 2026) is a meter-swap month - the outgoing [number removed] carries the real readings while the incoming [number removed]* registers are all present with zero movement. Meter number is join_unique; readings/consumption are collect:'sum'. The zero-movement registers add the same value to OLD and NEW so END-START still equals Total kWh exactly.
- READING TYPE letters seen: A (6 bills), S (1), N (1, WITH a real reading movement), E (zero-movement registers), I (water only). TRANSLATE covers A and E only, so reading_type is a join_unique of the RAW letters: 'A' translates to 'Actual', 'E' to 'Estimated', everything else passes through exactly as printed ('S', 'E/N'). NOTE FOR EDWIN: the Abaqulusi report guessed N = 'No Reading'. These bills CONTRADICT that - bill 1's TIME OF USE registers are type N and moved 730,253 -> 741,597 (11,344 kWh billed). So N is NOT 'no reading' in this vendor's scheme, and nothing here is invented: no letter beyond A/E is mapped.

ACCOUNT DETAILS LEDGER: DATE / CODE / DESCRIPTION / UNITS / TARIFF / VALUE, with '@' between UNITS and TARIFF on real levies and a '*' VAT flag before VALUE. Credits print a TRAILING minus.

COMPLETE CODE + DESCRIPTION CENSUS (every distinct line type over the 10 bills)
  TOU01P  'TOU: LPU: ELECTRICITY PEAK' (9) / 'FINAL USAGE ELECTRICIY' (1)     -> peak kWh + Rands
  TOU01S  'TOU: LPU: ELECTRICITY STANDARD' (9) / 'FINAL USAGE ELECTRICIY' (1) -> standard kWh + Rands
  TOU01O  'TOU: LPU: ELECTRICITY OFF-PEAK' (9) / 'FINAL USAGE ELECTRICIY' (1) -> off-peak kWh + Rands
  TOU03K  'TOU: LPU: DEMAND CHARGE' (9) / 'FINAL USAGE ELECTRICIY' (1)        -> Demand kVA + Demand Rands
  TOU03A  'TOU: LPU: ACCESS CHARGE' (9) / 'FINAL USAGE ELECTRICIY' (1)        -> NMD kVA + NMD Rands
  TOU01O  'ELECTRICITY BASIC CHARGE' (10, units 1.000)                        -> Other Charges Rands
  TOU01O/020108 'Reversal of Adj (Under|Over)billed ...' (4)                  -> PRIOR PERIOD (excluded)
  (wrapped) 'Adj of Consumption (Under|Over)billed Elec_Non-...Block_Tariff' (10) -> PRIOR PERIOD (excluded)
  010111  'WATER 0 - 30 KL' (7) / 'WATER BASIC CHARGE' (10)                   -> water
  010111  'Adj of Consumption Underbilled Water_Block_Tariff' (7)             -> water PRIOR PERIOD
  040111 (9) / 040102 (1) 'REFUSE REMOVAL' units 3.000                        -> refuse
  008888  'DIRECT DEPOSIT PAYMENT - THANK YOU' (trailing minus)               -> payments
  009008  'VAT'   /   000007 'INTEREST' (4 bills, no '*' flag)                -> tax / sundry
TOU01O IS OVERLOADED: it carries the off-peak energy line, the ELECTRICITY BASIC CHARGE line AND reversal lines, so every electricity rule keys on CODE **plus** the exact description - code alone would put the R964.03 basic charge into Off Peak kWh.
'FINAL USAGE ELECTRICIY' (the vendor's own misspelling, same string as on Alfred Duma bills) is NOT a reversal here: on bill 1 it is the only energy wording present, it carries the month's real units at the month's real tariffs, and it reconciles - it is the final invoice for the outgoing meter. It is therefore summed into the SAME buckets as the 'TOU: LPU:' lines.

PRIOR-PERIOD LINES - DELIBERATE CHOICE (EXCLUDED from the current-month electricity buckets):
bill 'MMM_...(12).pdf' (30 JUN 2026) carries 20 adjustment lines dated 04/06 - 24/06: ten wrapped 'Adj of Consumption (Under|Over)billed Elec_Non-<date> <TOUcode> ... Block_Tariff' lines, seven 010111 water adjustments, and four 'Reversal of Adj ...' lines (one under code 020108). They re-bill EARLIER months and they self-cancel in a chain: the wrapped elec adjustments (80,474.83) plus the water adjustments (1,447.74) equal 81,922.57, which is exactly the 'Reversal of Adj Underbilled' of -81,922.57; the +96,155.18 and the +/-36,545.19 pair then leave a net prior-period effect of +96,155.18 (elec 94,707.44, water 1,447.74). Folding that into June would make June's electricity cost meaningless (the month's own TOU levies are 109,528.61), so they are captured in their own fields mmm_prior_elec_adj_r / mmm_water_adj_r and kept out of Peak/Standard/Off-peak/Demand/NMD/Other/Total ex VAT. They ARE part of the VAT base, which is why the VAT identity reads the separate mmm_vatable_r rule and the roll-forward identity adds them back - both close.
THE DISCRIMINATOR IS STRUCTURAL, NOT DATE ARITHMETIC: every real levy prints '@ <tariff>' between UNITS and TARIFF; every adjustment/reversal prints '.000' units, a 0.[number removed] tariff and NO '@'. True for all 27 distinct code+description combinations in the folder.

WRAPPED-LINE TRAP: the wrapped adjustment lines are mangled by the PDF text order - the description 'Adj of Consumption Underbilled Elec_Non-Block_Tariff' is split and the ledger's own date and code are injected into the break, so the line reads 'Adj of Consumption Underbilled Elec_Non-04/06/2026      TOU03A   .000  0.[number removed]  *  8,670.87   Block_Tariff' and does NOT begin with a date. Its rule is anchored on the description instead, and the document-wide VAT-base rule is anchored on '* <amount>' followed by either end-of-line OR 'Block_Tariff' so those lines are not silently dropped from the VAT base.

TARIFF NAME: the bill does print one, inside the descriptions - 'TOU: LPU:' (Time Of Use, Large Power User). It is captured literally as mmm_tariff and mapped to canonical Tariff Name. It fills 9 of 10 bills; bill 1 is blank because every energy line on that statement is titled 'FINAL USAGE ELECTRICIY' instead. Nothing is derived or invented to fill that gap.

NOT PRINTED ANYWHERE (mapped '_none'): billing-period start date, cash, guarantee, security held, and any per-service or ex-VAT subtotal. There are no rates and no sewerage lines on this account at all - those services are simply absent, not missed.

RULE ZERO / RECONCILE IS CIRCULAR: no per-service subtotal and no ex-VAT electricity total is printed, so total_ex_vat_r is the sum of the same six parts the Rand columns hold and the app's reconcile check proves nothing. The three GENUINE checks are:
  1. kWh identity: sum(TIME OF USE CONSUMPTION) == TOU01P+TOU01S+TOU01O units == END-START readings. Exact on all 10 bills.
  2. kVA identity: the two KVA registers' CONSUMPTION values are the TOU03K and TOU03A billed units (as a set) on all 10 bills.
  3. Roll-forward: Opening Balance + payments + sum(all '*' lines) + printed VAT + INTEREST == printed TOTAL DUE == the ageing row's TOTAL DUE THIS MONTH. Both ends are printed figures the extraction did not construct.

Ageing row is 6 money columns and the LAST one is 'TOTAL DUE THIS MONTH' (not 'CLOSING BALANCE' as on Emalahleni/Abaqulusi). CURRENT is the net current balance, not the current levy, so recon 'current_ex' is left unmapped.

fields.label: Ageing row (last column = TOTAL DUE THIS MONTH)
VAT base (every '*'-flagged line, wrapped Block_Tariff lines included)
TIME OF USE register meter number(s)
OLD READING (summed over TIME OF USE registers)
NEW READING (summed over TIME OF USE registers)
kVA register CONSUMPTION values, as printed
Tariff name printed in the ledger descriptions
TOU tariff rates in force (R per kWh / per kVA, sorted, deduped)
'Reversal of Adj ...' electricity lines (prior period, no '@')
